test_raw_benchmark: test the raw_benchmark function with a tf.data.Dataset, num_iter, batch_size, and expected_num_examples
test_benchmark: test the benchmark function with a tf.data.Dataset and a plain Python iterable
test_benchmark_empty: test the benchmark function raises ValueError for empty datasets and works with single-element lists
build_raw_benchmark_result: build a RawBenchmarkResult dataclass with num_iter, num_examples, start_time, first_batch_time, end_time, batch_size, and durations_ns
run_benchmark: run the benchmark function on an iterable dataset to get a BenchmarkResult with stats and raw_stats DataFrames
